title: Rates and allowances: Inheritance Tax thresholds and interest rates
text:
This document contains information on the different thresholds in use for deaths going back to 1914.

 It also shows the changes in Inheritance Tax interest rates from October 1988.

 You can use this information to work out how much interest is due on an Inheritance Tax payment by using the Calculate Inheritance Tax interest tool.
changeNote: The 'Inheritance Tax interest rates from October 1988' table has been updated with the new interest rate of 8.00% and the interest on repayments of 3.00% from 24 November 2026.
